title: AI Assistant — Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: Chat · Code Completion · In-Editor Actions · Agents · MCP · BYOK

rows.label: Install
rows.value: Not bundled by default — install via Settings | Plugins | Marketplace → search AI Assistant

rows.label: IDEs
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, Rider, WebStorm, CLion, PhpStorm, RubyMine, RustRover, DataGrip, DataSpell + Android Studio

rows.label: Activation
rows.value: JetBrains AI subscription, BYOK API key, provider OAuth, or ACP-compatible external agent

rows.label: 30-day trial
rows.value: Click Start Free Trial in the AI Chat tool window; links to JetBrains Account (card required, no charge)

rows.label: AI Free tier
rows.value: 3 AI Credits / 30 days, available from IDE 2025.1+; no top-up allowed

rows.label: AI Hub widget
rows.value: Click the JetBrains AI widget in the window toolbar to check quota, plan, and settings

rows.label: Disable per-project
rows.value: JetBrains AI widget → Disable for This Project; or drop .noai file in project root

rows.label: Min IDE version
rows.value: 2023.3+ for paid; 2024.1.1+ for Community editions

rows.label: Cloud agents
rows.value: Run agents in an isolated JetBrains Air cloud environment; writes results to a separate branch for review & merge

rows.label: Agent Client Protocol
rows.value: ACP lets you connect external agents (e.g., opencode, goose, auggie) via ~/.jetbrains/acp.json

rows.label: Skills
rows.value: Reusable agent abilities (supported by Claude Agent & Codex); invoke with $skill-name in chat

rows.label: Junie Debug mode
rows.value: AI-powered debugger assistant in IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate; set breakpoints, inspect variables, evaluate expressions

rows.label: Next edit suggestions
rows.value: AI predicts the next code change after you edit; accept with Tab → Tab; not on AI Free tier

rows.label: Group with AI
rows.value: Experimental plugin clusters uncommitted/committed diffs into high/medium/low-impact groups for faster review

rows.label: Perforce MCP
rows.value: Configure a Perforce MCP server via Settings | Version Control | Perforce | Perforce MCP

rows.label: Java-to-Kotlin AI
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate: Code | Convert Java to Kotlin | AI-Assisted; uses kotlin-tooling-java-to-kotlin skill

rows.label: Open AI Chat
rows.value: Click the AI Chat button on the right toolbar; in DataGrip use More tool windows

rows.label: New chat
rows.value: Click New Chat or press Alt+Insert

rows.label: Send message
rows.value: Enter — send; Shift+Enter — new line; Ctrl+Shift+Enter — send to new chat

rows.label: Send Now
rows.value: Ctrl+Enter — interrupt ongoing generation and send prompt immediately

rows.label: Search in chat
rows.value: Ctrl+F in the chat pane highlights occurrences; also works in Chat History list

rows.label: Chat in editor tab
rows.value: Click Show Chats in Editor Tabs to open the current chat as a full editor tab

rows.label: Response language
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant → Receive AI Assistant chat responses in a custom language

rows.label: Chat waiting indicator
rows.value: Yellow dot in Chat History marks an agent chat that is paused and waiting for your approval

rows.label: @thisFile
rows.value: References the currently open file in the editor

rows.label: @file: / @folder:
rows.value: Attach a specific file or folder; also accepts drag-and-drop or Ctrl+F search in attachment picker

rows.label: @selection
rows.value: Attaches the code currently selected in the editor

rows.label: @localChanges
rows.value: Attaches uncommitted changes from VCS

rows.label: @commit:
rows.value: Adds a commit reference by hash or popup selection

rows.label: @symbol:
rows.value: Adds a named symbol, e.g. @symbol:FieldName

rows.label: @dbObject:
rows.value: Attaches a database schema or table (DataGrip / DB plugin)

rows.label: Codebase Mode
rows.value: Auto-gathers context from the project; disable via ! menu → Enable Codebase Mode to attach manually. Respects .aiignore

rows.label: Trigger manually
rows.value: Alt+Shift+\ — invoke cloud completion explicitly

rows.label: Accept all
rows.value: Tab — accept entire suggestion (configurable)

rows.label: Accept word
rows.value: Ctrl+→ — accept suggestion word by word

rows.label: Accept line
rows.value: End — accept suggestion line by line

rows.label: Reject
rows.value: Esc — dismiss the current suggestion

rows.label: Default model
rows.value: Mellum (JetBrains FIM model); override with an OpenAI-compatible provider in Settings | AI Completion

rows.label: Completion policy
rows.value: Focused (default) / Balanced / Creative — controls suggestion volume & filter strictness

rows.label: Completions in
rows.value: Editor code, AI Chat input, commit messages, and code comments (each toggleable in settings)

rows.label: Open AI Actions
rows.value: Alt+Enter → AI Actions or right-click → AI Actions

rows.label: Generate code (inline)
rows.value: Ctrl+\ on empty line → type prompt → Enter; on selected code → modify it

rows.label: Explain Code
rows.value: Select code → Alt+Enter → AI Actions | Explain Code

rows.label: Generate Unit Tests
rows.value: Caret in class/method → Alt+Enter → AI Actions | Generate Unit Tests

rows.label: Write Documentation
rows.value: Caret on declaration → right-click → AI Actions | Write documentation

rows.label: Find Problems
rows.value: Select code → floating popup → Find Problems

rows.label: Suggest Refactoring
rows.value: Select code → floating popup → Suggest Refactoring; then click Apply to write to file

rows.label: Accept / Discard changes
rows.value: After generation: Accept All to apply; Discard All or gutter Revert to reject individual hunks

rows.label: Ctrl+\
rows.value: Generate code on empty line or edit selected code in editor

rows.label: Alt+Shift+\
rows.value: Manually invoke cloud code completion

rows.label: Alt+Enter
rows.value: Open AI Actions context menu on current selection or caret

rows.label: Alt+Insert
rows.value: Open a new AI Chat

rows.label: Ctrl+F (chat)
rows.value: Search within the current chat conversation

rows.label: Ctrl+Shift+'
rows.value: Maximize / restore the AI Assistant tool window

rows.label: Shift+F6
rows.value: Rename symbol — AI suggests name options based on code context

rows.label: Configure shortcuts
rows.value: Settings | Keymap | Plugins | JetBrains AI Assistant

rows.label: Junie
rows.value: JetBrains autonomous agent; requires JetBrains AI subscription; reads AGENTS.md; respects .aiignore

rows.label: Claude Agent
rows.value: Anthropic; supports JetBrains AI, BYOK (Anthropic key), or Anthropic Console; reads CLAUDE.md

rows.label: Codex
rows.value: OpenAI; supports JetBrains AI, BYOK (OpenAI key), or ChatGPT OAuth; reads AGENTS.md

rows.label: GitHub Copilot
rows.value: GitHub OAuth only; reads AGENTS.md & CLAUDE.md; not available in Remote Development

rows.label: Operation modes
rows.value: Each agent has distinct modes (e.g., Junie: Brave; Claude: Auto / Plan / Bypass; Codex: Read-only / Agent / Full access)

rows.label: Rollback
rows.value: In the changed-files pane: hover a file → revert icon for single file, or Rollback button for all

rows.label: JetBrains Pick
rows.value: Default mode opens with JetBrains' recommended agent; selected by benchmark solve rate, cost & A/B tests

rows.label: Approve actions
rows.value: Agents ask permission before file ops/commands; choose Allow Once, Always allow, or Deny

rows.label: Add MCP server
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Model Context Protocol (MCP) → click +

rows.label: Transports
rows.value: STDIO (local subprocess), Streamable HTTP, and legacy SSE

rows.label: Import from Claude
rows.value: Click Import from Claude on the MCP settings page to reuse Claude Desktop's mcpServers config

rows.label: Use IDE as MCP server
rows.value: Settings | Tools | MCP Server → enable; auto-configures clients like Claude Code, Codex, VS Code

rows.label: Brave mode (MCP)
rows.value: Enable Run shell commands without confirmation in Settings | Tools | MCP Server

rows.label: Pass to agent
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Agents → enable Pass custom MCP servers or Pass IntelliJ MCP server

rows.label: Invoke manually
rows.value: Type / in chat input to see and run available MCP tool commands

rows.label: ACP config file
rows.value: Custom external agents defined in ~/.jetbrains/acp.json; IDE auto-detects installed ACP agents

rows.label: Cloud models
rows.value: Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok families via JetBrains AI service; select in chat model picker

rows.label: Auto model
rows.value: Set model to Auto in chat — AI Assistant picks the best cost/performance balance

rows.label: Reasoning models
rows.value: Brain icon in model picker = reasoning model; configurable reasoning level per agent

rows.label: BYOK setup
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys → select provider → enter API key → Test Connection

rows.label: Supported BYOK providers
rows.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google (Gemini API or Vertex AI ADC), OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, LM Studio

rows.label: Local models
rows.value: Ollama / LM Studio: specify Base URL in settings; default context window 64k tokens (adjustable)

rows.label: Assign to features
rows.value: Local / OpenAI-compatible models: assign Core features and Instant helpers models in Model Assignment section

rows.label: Completion provider
rows.value: Override Mellum: Settings | Providers & API keys | AI Completion → OpenAI Compatible with FIM/edit-prediction model

rows.label: Prompt Library
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Prompt Library — add custom prompts or edit built-in ones (e.g., commit message prompt)

rows.label: $SELECTION variable
rows.value: In custom prompts, inserts a Markdown code block of the currently selected code

rows.label: $GIT_BRANCH_NAME
rows.value: Use in the commit-message prompt to include the current branch name

rows.label: Save from chat
rows.value: Hover over a sent message → ... → Save Current Prompt to add it to the Prompt Library

rows.label: Project rules
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Rules → New Project Rules File → creates .aiassistant/rules/*.md

rows.label: Rule types
rows.value: Always / Manually (@rule:) / By model decision / By file patterns (*.kt) / Off

rows.label: Agent instructions
rows.value: Create AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md for Claude Agent) in project root; versioned with the repo

rows.label: /commands
rows.value: Built-in: /explain /refactor /web /docs /help; MCP tools & agents add more

rows.label: Generate commit msg
rows.value: In Commit tool window (Alt+0): click Generate Commit Message with AI Assistant

rows.label: Self-Review before commit
rows.value: Select changes → click Self-Review with AI; issues appear in Problems tool window

rows.label: Review rules file
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Project Settings → set Path to rules for AI Self-Review

rows.label: Explain commit
rows.value: In Git log: right-click commit(s) → Explain Commit with AI Assistant

rows.label: PR title & description
rows.value: In PR/MR creation dialog: click Generate a Title and Description with AI Assistant

rows.label: Merge with AI
rows.value: In Merge Revisions conflict dialog: click Merge with AI

rows.label: Incoming PR summary
rows.value: Enable GitHub Plugin: Generate a summary upon opening a Pull Request in AI Assistant settings

rows.label: Shelf title
rows.value: Silently shelving changes auto-generates a shelf name; disable in Settings | Tools | AI Assistant

rows.label: Data flow (JB AI)
rows.value: IDE → JetBrains AI service (no storage) → LLM provider; JB does not store data unless opt-in is enabled

rows.label: Detailed data opt-in
rows.value: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing → Send detailed code-related data (off by default)

rows.label: BYOK data flow
rows.value: Prompts & context sent directly to your BYOK provider; JetBrains never sees them

rows.label: .aiignore
rows.value: Create via Settings | AI Assistant | Project Settings; uses .gitignore syntax to block files from AI access

rows.label: Supported ignore files
rows.value: .aiignore, .cursorignore, .codeiumignore, .aiexclude — all respected if in project root

rows.label: Network block
rows.value: Block https://api.jetbrains.ai/ and https://api.app.prod.grazie.aws.intellij.net/ at network level

rows.label: View sent data
rows.value: Search Everywhere → Open AI Assistant Requests Log in Editor → reviews ai-assistant-requests.md

rows.label: Enterprise controls
rows.value: JetBrains IDE Services / JetBrains Central admins can restrict providers, agents, and MCP servers org-wide

rows.label: Start fresh chats
rows.value: Long chat threads inflate token cost exponentially; open a new chat for each unrelated task

rows.label: Attach precise context
rows.value: Use @file:, @symbol:, or drag-and-drop rather than pasting code into your message

rows.label: Plan before code
rows.value: Ask the agent for an implementation plan first; use Plan mode if supported; review before proceeding

rows.label: Define 'done'
rows.value: Include a verifiable success metric: "run ./gradlew test and confirm build passes"

rows.label: Use Auto model
rows.value: Let AI Assistant pick the model for everyday tasks; switch to a reasoning model only for complex problems

rows.label: Sensitive code & BYOK
rows.value: Use BYOK for data-sensitive projects so prompts go directly to your chosen provider, bypassing JetBrains

rows.label: Context trimming
rows.value: Set Trim message if it exceeds % of model context in settings to avoid silent truncation of large files

rows.label: IDE as MCP server
rows.value: Enable MCP Server plugin to let external agents (Claude Code, Codex) use IDE tools like build, search, and run

rows.label: AI Credits
rows.value: 1 AI Credit ≈ $1 USD; consumed by cloud features; resets every 30 days from first use

rows.label: AI Free
rows.value: 3 credits / 30 days, no top-up; not available on Community editions or Android Studio

rows.label: AI Pro (individual)
rows.value: 10 credits / 30 days at $10 USD; 20 credits / 30 days per-user for orgs at $20 USD

rows.label: AI Ultimate
rows.value: 35 credits (individual) / 70 credits (org) per 30 days; supports top-up

rows.label: Top-up credits
rows.value: Purchase extra credits via JetBrains AI widget → Buy; valid 12 months; shared across org if applicable

rows.label: Track usage
rows.value: JetBrains AI widget in window toolbar shows credits remaining and reset date

rows.label: Quota savers
rows.value: Use cost-effective models (no ruby icon), avoid large agent sessions, start new chats per topic

rows.label: Multiple licenses
rows.value: AI Chat options → Manage License to switch between active JetBrains AI licenses
